capabilities: install beta plugins from a GitHub repository path
check for and download plugin updates
disambiguation: Not a general plugin marketplace; it only installs and updates pre-release versions from GitHub repositories you add.
extras: Detailed documentation lives outside the README at an external link; the README also promotes the author's other products (JournalCraft, Cornell Notes Learning Vault).
motivation: The author built it to make life easier for developers and beta-testers who review and test plugins and themes.
problem: Testing unreleased plugins normally requires manually creating folders, downloading files, and copying them into the right place, and repeating that for every update.
summary: Plugin manager that installs and auto-updates beta versions of Obsidian plugins and themes directly from their GitHub repositories.
